name: Death's Step
summary: Death's Step is a blighted, tree-lined hollow tucked along the southern border of the Eastern Plaguelands near the shores of Darrowmere Lake. Hemmed in just west of the Undercroft, it crawls with vile Scourge creations and purveyors of disease.

sections.title: A Foul Hollow
sections.body: Tucked away near the northern water's edge of Darrowmere Lake and situated directly west of the tomb grounds of the Undercroft, Death's Step is an ominous pocket of Scourge corruption. Enclosed by dead and weeping trees, the clearing is prowled by putrifiers and warped miscreations. While small compared to the massive blighted ruins nearby, it serves as an unwelcome ambush point for anyone navigating the lake's banks.

faq.answer: Death's Step lies in the southern reach of the Eastern Plaguelands, right along the northern shore of Darrowmere Lake and directly west of the Undercroft.
The clearing is occupied by Scourge horrors, notably putrifiers and grotesque miscreations that wander among the diseased trees in small packs.

faq.q: Why is this area significant to travelers?
faq.answer: Aside from its perilous proximity to the crypts of the Undercroft and the banks of Darrowmere Lake, it is a treacherous natural choke point where the Scourge festers unchecked away from the main roads.

angles.text: The vile putrifiers and twisted miscreations brooding within this enclave are prime examples of the undead blight that Paladins are sworn to purge from Lordaeron.
